# CoArt Studio

> CoArt Studio is a full-service digital agency that helps startups and businesses grow through brand identity design, custom web and mobile app development, AI-powered automation, and digital marketing.

## About

CoArt Studio combines creative strategy with technology to deliver measurable results. We work with startups, entrepreneurs, and established businesses across industries.

## Services

### Brand Identity Design
We craft brand identities that make businesses impossible to ignore and easy to trust. Services include logo and visual identity design, brand strategy and positioning, brand guidelines, and pitch decks and collateral. Brands refreshed by CoArt report 35% stronger audience recall within 60 days.

### Web & Mobile App Development
We build fast, scalable, and beautiful digital products: websites, mobile apps, and SaaS platforms designed to convert visitors into customers. Services include custom web applications, mobile app development (iOS and Android), e-commerce and SaaS platforms, and API and backend architecture. CoArt clients see an average 2.4x lift in online conversions after launch.

### AI-Powered Automation
We embed AI where it creates the most impact: automating workflows, uncovering leads, and making brands visible where customers are searching. Services include AI search optimization (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), business AI integration, AI lead generation, and workflow automation. CoArt AI clients report up to 70% reduction in manual workload within the first 90 days.

### Digital Marketing
We build and execute marketing strategies that attract the right audience and convert them into paying customers. Services include SEO and content strategy, social media management, paid advertising (Google and Meta), and performance analytics. CoArt marketing clients average a 3x increase in qualified leads within the first 90 days.
